title: LIVE AIR QUALITY
freshness_label: LIVE / CURRENT MODEL (CAMS analysis), hourly check
source_name: ECMWF CAMS European air-quality analysis via Open-Meteo Air Quality API (PM2.5, no key, hourly)
variable: PM2.5 near-surface particulate concentration (CAMS model analysis; clearly identified as modeled, not observed)
what: Near-surface fine-particulate (PM2.5) conditions from the CAMS atmospheric-composition analysis: a continuous field flagging wildfire-smoke intrusions, urban haze, and regional pollutant transport over the Great Lakes. Low values mark clean air; orange, red, and purple mark progressively degraded, unhealthy air.
field: Air-quality science (atmospheric chemistry and public-health exposure assessment) tracks PM2.5, particles under 2.5 micrometers that penetrate deep into lungs. Concentrations in micrograms per cubic meter map to health-based breakpoints (good, moderate, unhealthy for sensitive groups, unhealthy, very unhealthy). This layer shows modeled concentration, not aerosol optical depth, and is labeled as model output rather than station observations.
